---
title: "How the checklists work"
---

You're about to collect data or submit a paper. You've done the work, but have you missed anything that would be difficult to fix later? A short checklist gives you a moment to check.

The idea comes from *The Checklist Manifesto* and the World Health Organization's checklist guidance. Both describe how short checks help people remember critical steps during complex work. Judgement still belongs with the people doing the work [@gawande2010checklist; @who2009checklist].

Start with [the whole-doctorate checklist](doctoral-journey.qmd) for a chronological view. Follow its links when you reach a stage that needs more detail.

## Two ways to use a checklist

**Read-do** means reading an item and completing it before moving to the next. Use it when the order matters, the process is unfamiliar or the consequences of omission are high.

**Do-confirm** means completing the work, pausing at a defined point, and then confirming that every critical condition is satisfied. Use it when skilled work cannot sensibly be reduced to a fixed sequence.

Each checklist tells you when to use it, what to check and what would mean pausing the work. It also tells you which records to keep. Adapt it with your team so it fits your method and local requirements.

## Choose a checklist {#the-phase-system}

| Pause point | Primary purpose | Format |
|---|---|---|
| [Starting candidature](starting-candidature.qmd) | Establish the minimum conditions for safe, organised work | Read-do |
| [First 90-day review](first-90-day-review.qmd) | Test whether the initial working system and direction are viable | Do-confirm |
| [Before committing to each study](before-study-commitment.qmd) | Prevent commitment to an incoherent or infeasible study | Do-confirm |
| [Before ethics or governance submission](before-ethics-submission.qmd) | Find contradictions and unmanaged risks before formal review | Read-do |
| [Before data collection](before-data-collection.qmd) | Confirm that permission, materials, people and data systems are ready | Do-confirm |
| [Before analysis](before-analysis.qmd) | Protect the link between the question, data, method and claim | Do-confirm |
| [Before writing up a study](before-study-write-up.qmd) | Reconcile the planned study with what actually happened | Do-confirm |
| [Before manuscript submission](before-manuscript-submission.qmd) | Prevent avoidable authorship, reporting and submission failures | Do-confirm |
| [Before thesis submission](before-thesis-submission.qmd) | Verify the exact final thesis and its formal requirements | Do-confirm |
| [Before project closure and handover](project-closure-handover.qmd) | Leave a recoverable, lawful and intelligible research record | Do-confirm |

## Keep it usable {#adapt-without-weakening}

Add checks your project needs, then try the checklist in practice. If an item needs a long explanation, link to the guidance. Keep the checklist itself short enough that you'll use it.
